correction_sql:
WITH corrections AS MATERIALIZED(
SELECT company_id,company_ordinal,session_date,ticker,identity_source_id,identity_source_ordinal,identity_record_sha256,qualification_event_id,dated_point_and_source_link_verified FROM population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.working_d02_adig_corroborated_points_v1
UNION ALL SELECT company_id,company_ordinal,session_date,ticker,identity_source_id,identity_source_ordinal,identity_record_sha256,qualification_event_id,dated_point_and_source_link_verified FROM population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.working_d02_sec_corroborated_points_v1),
reports AS MATERIALIZED(SELECT effective_date,values_json->>'symbol' ticker,count(*) n,min(record_sha256) record_sha,jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('source_id',source_id,'source_record_key',source_record_key,'record_sha256',record_sha256,'normalization_sha256',normalization_sha256,'source_published_at',source_published_at,'historical_received_at',historical_received_at,'available_at',available_at) ORDER BY source_id,source_record_key) records FROM population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.source_observation WHERE family_id='S01' AND values_json->>'symbol' IN ('ADIG','VMRK') GROUP BY effective_date,values_json->>'symbol')
SELECT c.*,b.point_source_state original_state,r.n report_count,r.records,
CASE WHEN c.dated_point_and_source_link_verified IS DISTINCT FROM true THEN 'CORRECTION_NOT_QUALIFIED' WHEN b.point_source_state='VERIFIED_POINT_AND_SOURCE_LINK' THEN 'EXISTING_VERIFIED_POINT_REQUIRES_CONFLICT_REVIEW' WHEN r.n IS NULL THEN 'NO_RETAINED_REPORT' WHEN r.n<>1 THEN 'MULTIPLE_REPORTS_HELD' ELSE 'CORRECTED_DATED_POINT_SOURCE_LINK_ONLY' END overlay_state
FROM corrections c LEFT JOIN population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.d02_anchor_source_point_v2 b ON b.company_ordinal=c.company_ordinal AND b.session_date=c.session_date
LEFT JOIN reports r ON r.effective_date=c.session_date AND r.ticker=c.ticker ORDER BY c.company_id,c.session_date;
full_projection_sql:
WITH companies AS MATERIALIZED(SELECT * FROM population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.working_accepted_companies_v1), dates AS MATERIALIZED(SELECT right(source_id,10)::date session_date FROM population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.source_document WHERE source_id LIKE 'S01:FINRA_CNMS:2026-%'),
corrections AS MATERIALIZED(SELECT company_id,session_date,ticker,identity_record_sha256,qualification_event_id FROM population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.working_d02_adig_corroborated_points_v1 WHERE dated_point_and_source_link_verified IS TRUE UNION ALL SELECT company_id,session_date,ticker,identity_record_sha256,qualification_event_id FROM population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.working_d02_sec_corroborated_points_v1 WHERE dated_point_and_source_link_verified IS TRUE), points AS MATERIALIZED(SELECT company_id,session_date,count(*) point_rows,min(ticker) ticker,bool_and(dated_anchor_point_and_source_value_link_verified) point_verified FROM (SELECT a.company_id,o.session_date,CASE WHEN corr.company_id IS NOT NULL AND o.point_source_state IS DISTINCT FROM 'VERIFIED_POINT_AND_SOURCE_LINK' THEN corr.ticker ELSE a.anchor_ticker END ticker,(o.point_source_state='VERIFIED_POINT_AND_SOURCE_LINK' OR corr.company_id IS NOT NULL) dated_anchor_point_and_source_value_link_verified FROM population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.d02_anchor_source_point_v2 o JOIN companies a ON a.selection_order=o.company_ordinal LEFT JOIN corrections corr ON corr.company_id=a.company_id AND corr.session_date=o.session_date CROSS JOIN population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.d02_anchor_source_completion_v2 c WHERE c.singleton AND c.status='COMPLETE_INDEPENDENTLY_VERIFIED' AND a.cohort_sha256=c.cohort_sha256 AND a.membership_acceptance_sha256=c.membership_acceptance_sha256 AND c.verified_grid_manifest_sha256 IS NOT NULL AND c.independent_review_event_id IS NOT NULL AND (SELECT count(*) FROM population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.d02_anchor_source_checkpoint_v2)=42 AND (SELECT count(*) FROM population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.d02_anchor_source_point_v2)=126000) points_base GROUP BY company_id,session_date),
reports AS MATERIALIZED(SELECT effective_date session_date,values_json->>'symbol' ticker,count(*) report_rows,min(record_sha256) report_sha FROM population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.source_observation WHERE family_id='S01' GROUP BY effective_date,values_json->>'symbol'),
cells AS MATERIALIZED(SELECT c.company_id,d.session_date,p.ticker,p.point_rows,p.point_verified,r.report_rows,r.report_sha,
CASE WHEN p.point_rows IS DISTINCT FROM 1 OR p.point_verified IS DISTINCT FROM true THEN 'DATED_IDENTITY_HELD'
WHEN r.report_rows IS NULL THEN 'NO_RETAINED_REPORT_FOR_DATED_SYMBOL'
WHEN r.report_rows<>1 THEN 'MULTIPLE_REPORTS_REQUIRE_MARKET_RULE'
ELSE 'DATED_POINT_SOURCE_LINK_ONLY' END state
FROM companies c CROSS JOIN dates d LEFT JOIN points p USING(company_id,session_date) LEFT JOIN reports r ON r.session_date=d.session_date AND r.ticker=p.ticker)
SELECT clock_timestamp() checked_at,session_date,count(*) selected_company_cells,
count(*) FILTER(WHERE state='DATED_POINT_SOURCE_LINK_ONLY') candidate_links,
count(*) FILTER(WHERE state='DATED_IDENTITY_HELD') identity_held,
count(*) FILTER(WHERE state='NO_RETAINED_REPORT_FOR_DATED_SYMBOL') no_retained_report,
count(*) FILTER(WHERE state='MULTIPLE_REPORTS_REQUIRE_MARKET_RULE') multiple_reports,
encode(sha256(convert_to(string_agg(jsonb_build_array(company_id,session_date,ticker,point_rows,point_verified,report_rows,report_sha,state)::text,E'\n' ORDER BY company_id),'UTF8')),'hex') projection_sha256
FROM cells GROUP BY session_date ORDER BY session_date;
limitations: No full instrument/reportability denominator or economic qualification
No original historical receipt/publication proof; retained available_at is October ingestion, not target-period availability
Original grid and source_observation unchanged; native binding not installed
Distinct review of overlay output and native code required; no family acceptance
Do not extend ADIG correction to Aug3 or VMRK to Sep8/Sep10
